text:
nina_product: RCA posted for the morning incident where traffic was routed to an incompatible quantized model version. Link: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2469990001-quantized-mismatch

nina_product: Impact: brief spike in model errors (~4% of requests) for ~10 minutes. No user data leak. Customers affected: small set of paid routes.

nina_product: Key owners & actions:
• eng: add model-compat check in deploy pipeline (mira_eng)
• sre: add alert for model_binary_checksum mismatch (oscar_sre)
• ops: add canary load verification step (jon_ops)

mira_eng: ack — I'll add the compatibility check as a pre-deploy job and open a PR today.

oscar_sre: ack — alert rule proposal: model_checksum_mismatch > 0 for 1m. I'll add runbook. ETA tomorrow AM.

jon_ops: will update canary checklist to include a quick inference sanity test. Also will run a targeted canary tomorrow morning.

notif-bot: RCA document published by nina_product — https://redwood.internal/rcas/2469990001-quantized-mismatch

nina_product: Scheduling checkpoints: 48h quick sync and 14-day closure review. Please put PR links and ETA in the RCA doc under 'owners & status'.

mira_eng: reproduction script added to the doc:
```
# minimal repro
./scripts/run_inference_check --model=quant-v2 --input=sample_prompt.json
```

oscar_sre: adding alert and attaching the rollback playbook.

nina_product: thanks everyone. Holding external comms until comms team approves. Closing thread for now — ping me if blockers.
